card.title: Samsung S23 Ultra CPU Swap Guide

source.title: Samsung S23 Ultra CPU Swap Guide

claims.statement: An S23 Ultra CPU swap for data needs four chips moved: CPU (hardware keys), UFS (encrypted data), RAM (not paired but stacked on the CPU) and a small EEPROM ('pin code IC') without which the PIN won't be accepted.
There is no way to extract the data without the original CPU working with its UFS.

procedure: Move CPU, UFS, RAM and the EEPROM to a working donor board.
card.caveats: Author notes the EEPROM's name is unknown. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
